0022600169.text: The Nuggets (3-2, winners of their last two, 4th in the Northwest and 1 game back, 9th in the West) host the Trail Blazers (4-1, first in the Northwest, 3rd in the West, and winners of their last game). Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 137-132 victory in Denver on April 6, 2026.
